profile.headline: SWE@TikTok | ECE@Carnegie Mellon
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems at AWS (Elastic File System). I specialize in performance optimization, storage systems, and backend infrastructure, with hands-on experience diagnosing low-level bottlenecks and improving reliability at scale.

Strong foundation in software and hardware from Carnegie Mellon University (ECE), with production experience in C++, Java, Python, Go, and AWS services.

positions.title: Software Engineer (AWS Elastic File System)
positions.description:
• Designed and optimized performance-critical components in AWS Elastic File System, supporting large-scale distributed storage workloads
• Diagnosed and resolved low-level latency issues through deep analysis of NFS behavior and system metrics
• Improved reliability and throughput by identifying bottlenecks across hardware and software boundaries

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Penta Security Systems is a leading provider of web and data security products and solutions based in Seoul, South Korea. 
Responsibilities 
• Developed customized beat that ships AMO data (car data blockchain infrastructure) 
• Researched / self-taught Elastic Stack and led a seminar in front of senior engineers 
• Created Kibana dashboard using logstash and elasticsearch that updates on the status of ethereum node with ethereum JSON RPC endpoint

projects.title: Ultimate Chess
projects.description:
Ultimate chess is a capstone project that supports a chess game with an AI without any software interaction. 

Responsibilities:
Developed CV algorithm to detect user’s moves from video input with C++
Developed Chess Logic Engine with Python to verify valid moves
